title: Understanding Poverty in China
description: This educational video explores the challenges of poverty in China, highlighting key statistics and real-life examples.

scenes.script: In rural China, many families still struggle with poverty, impacting their daily lives and futures.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view of a rural Chinese village with traditional houses, rice fields, and families working in the fields, showcasing the landscape and lifestyle, vibrant colors, bright daylight, professional documentary style, silent video only.

scenes.script: A significant portion of the Chinese population lives in extreme poverty, illustrating the ongoing challenge.
Education plays a crucial role in lifting families out of poverty, as seen in various communities.
scenes.prompt: Footage of children in a rural Chinese classroom, engaged in learning with a teacher, highlighting their enthusiasm, traditional Chinese school setting, colorful classroom decorations, bright daylight, professional documentary style, silent video only.

scenes.script: Efforts to improve living conditions show hope for the future, but challenges remain in eradicating poverty.
